followUpPlan.cadence: Review no more than twice in the first week unless Google Search Console changes the issue state.
followUpPlan.reviewSurface: Google Search Console Page indexing issue detail for Discovered - currently not indexed

reviewChecklist: Confirm whether validation status is still started, passed, failed, or waiting for Google systems.
Record the affected URL count shown in GSC without copying account UI or private session text.
If sample URLs change, update the sanitized sample evidence and rerun seo:gsc-discovered-samples.
If GSC shows failed validation, inspect failed sample URLs for status, canonical, sitemap, noindex, internal links, and title coverage before changing content.
If GSC shows passed validation or affected URLs decrease, record the new sanitized status and wait for Performance query data before keyword backlog work.
blockedActions: Do not repeatedly click Validate fix while validation is already started.
Do not request indexing at scale for all discovered URLs.
Do not infer Google indexing status from site-side evidence alone.
Do not sync screenshots that contain visible account UI unless explicitly approved.
nextEngineeringAction: Run npm run seo:gsc-validation-follow-up-validate before GSC follow-up, then update the sanitized evidence only when GSC status or sample URLs change.
privacyBoundary: This follow-up plan excludes account identifiers, cookies, tokens, raw private GSC UI text, and screenshot paths.
